result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers group all 14 real toggles into the same four sensible sections and make marketing opt-in. B handles the special controls better: it puts both masters and quiet hours at the top, ties quiet hours to push, and adds a channel column and a message for when push is off. A places quiet hours at the bottom, though it does add a useful 'Recommended' label on frost alerts. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use the real toggle names to make the same four sensible groups, put the push and email masters first, and treat quiet hours as a schedule row rather than a toggle. A ties quiet hours more closely to the push master and offers a drill-down option for later. B is a bit stronger on telling urgent alerts from marketing, with a 'Recommended' label on frost alerts and marketing hidden behind a disclosure. The two strengths roughly cancel out.
